hook.es: Un mundo no tiene por qué existir solo para uno.
hook.en: A world doesn't have to exist for just one.

objective: The Traveler realizes the Peskids system is a reusable pattern, not a one-off. First wide view of the Parallel World showing many worlds beginning to connect.

metadata.call_to_action: Un blueprint puede convertirse en muchos mundos.

captions.es: De un mundo a un blueprint.
captions.en: From one world to a blueprint.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: Wide establishing shot of the Parallel World from above, many small worlds beginning to connect by light-threads

notes: Theme: recognizing patterns — the shift from building one thing to building a way of building things.
Emotional conflict: ambition growing faster than confidence.
Visual motif: first wide/aerial reveal of the full Parallel World, many worlds visible at once.
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 05.
